item.tib: de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel
item.skt: tat+wa saM gra ha pany+dzi ka
item.coloph: de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon chen po ka ma la shI las mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po de ben dra b+ha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsA ba shAkya'i dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur/ /brtse ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'/ /kun la rab 'byam rtog ge'i gtso/ /chos kyi grags pa gnyis pa des/ /gsal ba'i tshig gi bkod gzhu 'di/ /bdag gzhan gzhung lugs rgya mtsho yis/ /mthar son mkhas pa lha dbang blo/ /bsnyen las grub mtha' mtha' dag la/ /blo yi snang pa thob nas bsgyur/ /sngon gyi sgyur byed mkhas rnams kyis/ /ji lta'i bgrod lam tshe rnams kyis/ /'bad pas mthong bar ma gyur gang / /ci zhig ltar te bdag gis te/ /bdag ni brtson dang mi ldan zhing / /shes rab lhag pa med mod kyang / /'di ltar don dang rjes mthun zhing / /tshig gi sdeb sbyor rab gsal ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis byin rlabs sam/ /skye ba gzhan du goms par la/ /'on kyang brtson 'grus brtsams rnams kyis/ /nyes pa dor la legs pa long / /dpal ldan rigs gsum mgon po'i rgyud/ /stod ris mun pa'i snang gyur pa/ /rje rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i dbon/ brtan zhin mi 'gyur gzi brjid ldan/ /dgongs zab dam pa'i lam la dgyis/ /mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran zil gnon pa/ /mnga' bdag dbang phyug dam ba'i rje/ /bsod nams rtse yis bkas bskus nas/ /gzhung lugs ngan pa kun 'joms shing / /bde gshegs bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /dpal ldan pad+ma'i dang tshul gyis/ /don chen ldan pa'i bstan bcos 'di //bsgyur pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun/ /lta ngan thams cad rab bcom nas/ /bkur bar dka' pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa yin rings 'dzin par shog /'di tshigs su bcad pa khri brgyad stong yod/ /bam po drug cur byaso
